pages.title: Gravity
pages.description: Causes blocks and entities to fall. When augmented with Extend Time, players will have their flight disabled and will obtain the Gravity effect. While afflicted with Gravity, entities will rapidly fall and take double falling damage.

While wearing an Earth Focus, and augmented with Sensitive, will create a gravity field that pull entities towards its center (filter-compatible). If the gravity well is cast directly on an entity, it will follow said entity.
